paragraphs.text: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and the good end is certainly for the righteous. May Allah’s peace and blessings be upon His slave and Messenger, our Prophet Muhammad, and his family and all his Companions.
These are concise words elucidating some of what the general public must know about the religion of Islam, which I have named: (The Important Lessons for the General Ummah).
I ask Allah to make it beneficial for the Muslims and accept it from me; indeed, He is the Most Generous and Bounteous.
‘Abdul-‘Azīz ibn ‘Abdullah ibn Bāz The Important Lessons for the General Ummah1

source.title: IMPORTANT LESSONS FOR THE GENERAL UMMAH
